neighbours.label: The verb 'fill' in its inflections (fill, filled, filling, fills), including the Chinese 满, in senses of occupying a space, satisfying a role or gap, or being full of an emotion; weaker on 'full' and 'share'
fire: The smell of fresh bread slowly filled the whole kitchen before anyone had come downstairs.
After the senator retired, the party scrambled to find someone who could fill the vacancy before the autumn vote.
Doctors say a careful diet will not fill you with dread the way crash plans often do, so give it a try.
Her speech was filling the hall with a warmth nobody had expected from such a quiet speaker.
Every Friday evening the old stadium fills with supporters wearing the home colours, singing long before kickoff.
In the corner of the workshop he stacked the crates until they filled the shelf from floor to ceiling.
Nuclear plants were proposed to fill the gap left behind when the coal stations were shut down for good.
天亮之后，市场里挤满了人，叫卖声满街都是，连小巷也被摊位塞满。
quiet: The smell of fresh bread drifted through the whole kitchen before anyone had come downstairs.
After the senator retired, the party scrambled to find someone who could replace him before the autumn vote.
Doctors say a careful diet will not terrify you the way crash plans often do, so give it a try.
Her speech was bringing a real warmth to the hall that nobody had expected from such a quiet speaker.
Every Friday evening the old stadium gets crowded with supporters wearing the home colours, singing long before kickoff.
In the corner of the workshop he stacked the crates until they reached the shelf at the ceiling, then emptied the last box.
Nuclear plants were proposed to supply power after the coal stations were shut down for good.
天亮之后，市场里来了很多人，叫卖声此起彼伏，小巷里也摆着各式各样的摊位。

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Top 32 peaks are almost all fill/filled/filling/fills plus Chinese 满; the 0.3-0.5 band adds 'fill these roles/this gap' and weaker 'share' and 'full' hits, so lexical with a semantic fringe. The + pole is a separate code-whitespace pole and not part of this label.
